subject: This Labor Day

body:
| I hope you have enjoyed your Labor Day weekend.

This is a day to recognize the sacrifices of so many laborers before us in the fight for workers’ rights.

Ohio has its own storied labor movement history, from manufacturing to major industry and so much more.

It’s only thanks to these workers that as Americans, we can spend so much more time with our families: Our 8 hour work day, our 5 day work week, and this 3 day weekend.

So I hope you take time today to honor the workers that paved the way for our lives today, and those who continue the work to better our community.

In Congress, I’ll continue my work as a public servant to advocate for OH-01 workers. It’s only because of their labor that our district will flourish — and they deserve a true voice in Washington fighting for them.

Thank you,

Greg Landsman

name: John Fetterman
subject: The U.S. Senate doesn’t need another advocate for CEOs or shareholders.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I know I said I wasn’t going to email you today, but I wanted to share some thoughts about Labor Day.
# [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/388?refcode=em20220905-7140-header&t=1&akid=7140%2E434096%2Ex3Ap_y)
Hi Derek, it’s John Fetterman.
I know I said I wasn’t going to email you today, but I want to share some thoughts with you about what we’re celebrating this weekend. **Will you please give me a moment to explain?**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220905?refcode=em20220905-7140&refcode2=7140_434096_x3Ap_y&akid=7140%2E434096%2Ex3Ap_y)
**This long Labor Day Weekend was brought to you by, you guessed it, the labor movement.** So were the two-day weekend, the eight-hour workday, and nearly every other workplace protection that we take for granted.
But these rights were not given, they were won by the blood and sweat of workers who recognized their shared power. And these rights are not universal, as millions of gig workers employed by corporations like Uber + Lyft are deprived of rights as basic as the minimum wage, insurance benefits, or the ability to unionize. And millions of other care workers, service workers, and other low-wage workers do not receive benefits or time off.
I live across the street from a Steelworkers union hall in Braddock, PA, and I’ve had the privilege of traveling across this commonwealth to speak with working people and union members who show the importance of a strong labor movement.
**I know firsthand the power of a strong union.** When I was born to two very young parents, my father worked as a union grocery worker with the UFCW in Reading, PA, stocking shelves at the Shop-Rite. The union helped him work his way through college.
But for decades union membership has faltered. And as a result, working people are losing out while corporations are making record profits on workers’ backs.
While corporate bosses and shareholders rake in millions of dollars, working people — the people who put their bodies + lives on the line during the pandemic and who are putting in work on factory floors — are getting sold out, squeezed, and ripped off. And let’s face it, our leaders in Washington are to blame.
For too long, out-of-touch politicians in Washington have sold out the people on factory floors to benefit their friends in corporate boardrooms. They’ve passed bad trade deals that have sent thousands of good-paying union jobs overseas. They’ve failed to increase the minimum wage. And they’ve turned a blind eye as CEOs continue to rip off working people, fight tooth and nail to roll back the rights of workers, and blunt the power of unions.
It’s Washington’s fault that the union membership rate has been cut in half since 1983, allowing corporations like Amazon to take their anti-worker, union-busting strategies to new extremes. And, it’s Washington’s fault that the minimum wage has remained at $7.25 for the last 13 years – the longest amount of time without an increase since 1938.
**But all across America, workers are fighting back, banding together to stand up for their rights. And they’re winning.**
Amazon workers unionized their first warehouse in New York City. Baristas at Starbucks are organizing and winning union elections all over the country, including many here in PA. And a group of BCTGM workers in Lancaster united to defeat a two-tier pay scale; and in the process, they won themselves a raise.
But while workers across the country walk the picket line and organize their workplaces, they need to know that our leaders in Washington have their backs and are taking concrete actions to support them. **It’s time that our politicians stand up for the people who built this country and who keep it running.**
That’s how I’ve always led here in PA — because I’ve never forgotten the stability my father’s union was able to provide our family.
Over the past year alone, I have been on countless picket lines across PA — from the BCTGM workers on strike in Lancaster, to the Ironworkers on strike in Erie, and everywhere in between. And I’ve sent emails just like this one raising money directly for striking unions’ strike funds — one of the only politicians ever to do so.
I don’t say this for a pat on the back, but to demonstrate how strong my support for the workers of PA really is. **When workers ask me to be there, I’ll always show up and have their backs.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220905?refcode=em20220905-7140&refcode2=7140_434096_x3Ap_y&akid=7140%2E434096%2Ex3Ap_y)
**That’s the difference between my multi-millionaire opponent Dr. Oz and me.** While I stand with working people, he stands with his filthy rich friends, who happen to run the companies ripping off working people. He doesn’t think that our embarrassingly low minimum wage needs to be increased. And he certainly wouldn’t want to dent the bonuses of his CEO pals and shareholder buddies.
The reality is that he’s personally invested in many of these companies. When his CEO pals make more money, he makes more money. **It’s that simple.**
The U.S. Senate certainly doesn’t need another advocate for CEOs + shareholders. What the Senate needs is more people who will be ruthless in their fight for workers.
To truly support working people, our leaders in Washington must pass the PRO Act. And we must meet the reality of an increased cost of living by raising the minimum wage to at least $15 an hour.
The Union Way of Life is sacred. Workers built this country + they keep it running every single day. It’s past time Washington gets to work. I’ll make sure they do when I show up in January.
Thanks for hearing me out + I hope you’ve had a great Labor Day Weekend.
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of PA
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220905?amount=5&refcode=em20220905-7140&refcode2=7140_434096_x3Ap_y&akid=7140%2E434096%2Ex3Ap_y)**

name: Charles Booker
subject: When working people win, we all win
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

First: I want to wish you and your loved ones a happy Labor Day. It is a
legacy we should never forget: that every win for working people is a win
for us all.

Right now, 71% of Americans approve of labor unions, the highest number
recorded in 57 years. What we are witnessing right now across the country,
from Amazon to Starbucks to Apple, is quite simply a labor revolution.

There’s a reason why unions have lined up to support our movement –
because we are fighting for real, radical solutions that will lift up
working people and combat decades of exploitation by corporate interests.

Here in Kentucky, we are at the bottom of nearly every quality of life
index. Our schools are underfunded, hundreds of thousands of people
haven’t had clean drinking water in decades, and one in four people in
Appalachia are living in poverty.

Good jobs with a dignified wage, a strong union, and healthy working
conditions could transform life for millions across our commonwealth. And
that future is within reach.

I have fought for that future for years and I’m not stopping now. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220905.Qp_9Dz&refcode=em20220905-2445&t=1001&akid=2445%2E346206%2E2VeXtw ]With
your support, we can bring our movement to the U.S. Senate – can you
sustain our campaign with a $5 donation now?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220905.Qp_9Dz&refcode=em20220905-2445&t=1020&akid=2445%2E346206%2E2VeXtw ]Contribute $5 →

AFL-CIO has given Rand Paul an 11% lifetime score – because he’s spent his
entire tenure in the Senate advancing his anti-worker agenda. Instead of
fighting for the people of Kentucky, he’s fought tirelessly to undermine
us at every turn. a

Make no mistake: Rand Paul is dangerous. He is genuinely committed to
dismantling the labor rights and protections our ancestors fought for.
That’s why he introduced a bill that would impose Right to Work rules
across the country.

Let me be blunt: working people in Kentucky cannot afford six more years
of Rand Paul. None of us can. That’s why we must do everything in our
power so I can unseat him this November.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220905.Qp_9Dz&refcode=em20220905-2445&t=1021&akid=2445%2E346206%2E2VeXtw ]I promise you this: I will fight for you every day, from the hood, to
the holler, to the United States Senate. So if you’re with me, will you
contribute any amount and fund our movement?

Together,

Charles

name: Matt Whitaker
subject: We MUST go on the offensive.
body:
| | | Peter, Former President Trump is going on the offensive and appears to be launching a full-scale fight against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). We here at the America First Policy Institute are joining the fight. I'm sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump's home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can't afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President's home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that 's exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61200266:6JfB-IVNk:m:1:3317145305:621CDC692A2C4D42AD21B078479D3EB9:r) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you ... ** **[Will you chip in before it's to help ensure our efforts can continue?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61200266:6JfB-IVNk:m:1:3317145305:621CDC692A2C4D42AD21B078479D3EB9:r)**[ ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61200266:6JfB-IVNk:m:1:3317145305:621CDC692A2C4D42AD21B078479D3EB9:r) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we're ready to make a HUGE difference for our country--ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you 'll consider sending in a donation of $25, $35, or $50 today. ** ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61200266:6JfB-IVNk:m:1:3317145305:621CDC692A2C4D42AD21B078479D3EB9:r) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We've seen it time and time again. Castro's Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao's China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I 'll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn't have the same fate. Will you? ** ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61200266:6JfB-IVNk:m:1:3317145305:621CDC692A2C4D42AD21B078479D3EB9:r)
---

subject: Labor Day Push to Victory!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heidi for Governor
body:
With just 64 days until the election, the polls show we are in a virtual tie with Jared Polis. We need your help to make sure we are victorious in November.
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-r/) Hi Peter, I'm a mom on a mission to build a brighter future for families in Colorado, as the first mom EVER in the governor's mansion. Happy Labor Day to all the hard-working families out there that are the lifeblood of our economy. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-y/) **If our kids are not okay, Colorado is not okay!** I have four beautiful children who have given me the honor of being a mom. For those of you who have not run into them on the campaign trail, I'd love to tell you a little bit about them. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-j/) Tori is 27 years old. You may have seen her behind-the-scenes snapping videos and photos of me for social media on the campaign trail! She has returned home after eight years in Oregon (go Ducks!), and we are thrilled to have her (and my grandpup Poppy) back.Hollie is 13, officially a teenager. She's the most amazing baker, who cooks beautiful cakes and treats for every special occasion. She even made custom Heidi for Gov cookies and a 3-tier cake for primary night. She has a heart of gold and is also becoming quite the tennis player.My 10-year-old twins, Jack and Jenna, are the dynamic duo. Jack is the sports KING. He's into basketball, golf, lacrosse, football, and cross-country. Jack is always on the move from one practice to the next. He's also a smarty pants, from being a math whiz to wanting to be in Space Force one day!Jenna is all in on soccer--the only one who followed in my footsteps as a soccer player growing up. I wouldn't be surprised if she followed in my "political" footsteps one day with her passion and drive, but her dream is to start a doggy hotel. Sound familiar? My kids are the reason I'm running for governor. Over the last four years, Colorado has become the MOST DANGEROUS STATE TO BE A KID. From suicide rates to drug addiction and fentanyl poisoning, to the fact that 60% of our kids can't read, write, or do math at grade level. **Now is the time!****We're gaining on Polis and are now in a deadheat!** [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-t/) [**Click here to read**](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-i/) **Campaign Trail:** I'm heading out to the Western Slope for our first debate. Unfortunately, but not unpredictably, Jared Polis will not be joining me. I'm committed to being a governor for all of Colorado, and that means meeting the people where they are at.Over the weekend, state leader and County Commissioner Felix Lopez joined my running mate Danny Moore on the campaign trail, walking together in the Fiesta Day Parade down in Pueblo and the Labor Day Parade in Las Animas.I attended a Law Enforcement Awareness event in Sedalia and spent a lot of time in Pueblo at the State Fair with our state's amazing farmers, ranchers, and our young, FUTURE ag leaders. There are just 64 days until the election! We need your help. An easy way to show support is through social media. Head to our website: **[heidiforgovernor.com/action](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-d/) **to download one of these social media graphics. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-h/) I appreciate each and every one of you, the calls, texts, emails, and appearances at our campaign events. The time is now. Please consider signing up to make calls, attend events, or, if you can afford it, make a donation to help get the word out. Find out more at: [**https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/volunteer-training/**](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-k/) See you on the trail!Heidi [$10](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-u/) [$50](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-n/) [$100](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-p/) [Other](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-x/) [Volunteer](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-m/) Never miss a beat, follow me on social media! [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-c/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-q/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-a/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-f/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qjrttlk-ttjjilthht-z/) | Heidi for Governor
PO Box 754

Team, here’s the truth: I spent days before the launch of our poll worker recruitment campaign worrying about its success. I know it’s a big deal to ask our supporters to spend their Election Day volunteering.

But I was blown away by how many of you stepped up! We’ve already recruited over 2,200 poll workers. I’ve never felt more confident about the power of this team.

We’re just starting this program though -- and we haven’t raised all the funds it will take to run it along with all of AOTL’s other efforts. For the poll recruitment program alone, there are trainings we still need to develop and materials to provide volunteers.

[**Will you chip in whatever you can to make sure we don’t run out of the resources required to run our poll worker recruitment campaign and any of our other democracy-saving programs?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50278850/365300574/-1863468049?refcode=20220906_AOTL_F_resend_augeom1_ActivesXopeners&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEwMWYxYWE4LWNhMmQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZkiebS5i5V0mLW6DOfqGxjk9fWz4RpAHxKE7uV-wkuk=)

The supporters [**signing up to volunteer to be poll workers**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50278853/365300577/-1807428003?refcode=20220906_AOTL_F_resend_augeom1_ActivesXopeners&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEwMWYxYWE4LWNhMmQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ZkiebS5i5V0mLW6DOfqGxjk9fWz4RpAHxKE7uV-wkuk=&emci=4db100f2-cb2a-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=101f1aa8-ca2d-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=8431045) are heroes for our democracy, but so are the supporters funding democracy-saving work.

subject: Opportunities This Week / Reaching the Vast
body:
Hello Patriots!
The fundraisers were a success and involved a lot of hard work! Thank you to all who participated, attended, donated or volunteered!

September is packed with opportunities to **volunteer** , or **show up at an event wearing your Geels shirt** , enjoying whatever is going on. Let's demonstrate to District 4 that Courtney has a presence in these communities!

_Thursday, September 8 - 7:00pm - Get Involved! ORANGE COUNTY_
Orange County GOP Meeting
125 Boone Square St, Hillsborough
For more information:[ ](http://goog_1762619928)<https://orange.nc.gop/>

_Friday - Sunday, September 9-11 ALAMANCE COUNTY_
ALCOVETS Balloon Festival - COME OUT AND SUPPORT OUR VETERANS
$25 per carload for parking - All proceeds go to Alamance County Veterans
Big 3 Day event! Balloons lift off every day at 7AM and 5PM

_We have volunteers, just show up wearing your Geels shirt and stop by our booth!_
For more information: <https://www.alcovets.org/balloon-festival>

_Saturday, September 10 - 9:00am-12:30pm ORANGE COUNTY_
Orange County Door Knocking with Charles Lopez Team
OCGOP Headquarters
125 Boone Square St, Hillsborough
**!!!WE NEED VOLUNTEERS!!!** Pizza provided - All county volunteers invited
To volunteer, please contact Marianne at [marianne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:marianne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

_Saturday, September 10 - 11:00am-5:00pm GRANVILLE COUNTY_
16th Annual NC Hot Sauce Contest & Festival
101 Main St., Oxford
**!!!WE NEED VOLUNTEERS!!! Can you spare an hour or more?**
To volunteer, contact Noah at [noah@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:noah@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
_Spectators show up wearing your Geels shirt and stop by our booth!_
For more information: <https://nchotsaucecontestandfestival.com/>

_Saturday, September 10 - 12:00pm-7:00pm DURHAM COUNTY_

Sneakerville
Durham Convention Center
301 W Morgan St., Durham
$20 entrance fee
_We have volunteers, just show up wearing your Geels shirt and stop by our booth!_
For more information: <https://sneakerville.io/>

**Calling all Facebookers, Instagrammers and Tweeters**!

Please turn your notifications on for Courtney's accounts. Whenever Courtney posts something, comment, like and share it! As you know, this will push her message out and enable us to reach so many more people.

**Calling all Po****dcasters!**
Do you know someone who is willing to have Courtney on their show? Go through your library and reach out to someone who might be interested in having her on and send me the contact info! This is all about networking. Someone who knows someone who knows someone 😊

**Contact WRAL**
We are working on trying to set up an interview with WRAL. Please email the station and tell them you want to hear from Courtney. Tell others to do the same! Use this link to contact them:
<https://www.wral.com/Contact-Us/1007423/>

**SAVE THE DATES:**
**Early Voting - October 20 - November 5**
**Election Day - November 8**
Be thinking about days/times you can volunteer at the polls!

Share this link with potential **volunteers** to sign up:

<https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/>

Share this link with potential **donors to donate** :

Hello,
Have you ever heard the term “tracker?” I know I hadn’t until I decided to run for office.
“Trackers” are what political campaign staff call what are essentially professional stalkers. They’re paid by Republican Super PACs and dark money organizations to follow you around with a video camera literally everywhere you go – yelling ridiculous questions and trying to get you to say something that they can edit up and spin into a fake scandal on Fox "News."
Well, professional trackers now show up to all my events with Iowa voters, hired and paid to be there by the “unofficial research arm of the Republican Party.”
Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are going to spend millions lying about me in TV ads. They’re scared because I’m a hard target for Republicans. They know that I can excite Independent voters and maybe even some pro-democracy Republicans to vote for someone who lives a life of Iowa values. **And if I defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue, Democrats will hold onto our Senate majority.**

Join HFF in the fight for America's sovereignty.

| Peter,
Last week, I went to Pennsylvania to **campaign for my good friend, Doug Mastriano** , the Republican nominee for Governor of Pennsylvania.
Doug's a **principled defender of conservative values, liberty, and the American Dream**...and I know that he'll govern by putting freedom first, just like I do down here in Florida.
Doug's **down by just 3 points** in the polls, but his opponent has a _ton_ of money to dump into this race, as well as the unified support of Big Tech and the Leftist Media.
**Doug needs our immediate help if he 's going to pull off a big victory on November 8.**
I told Doug my top supporters could always be trusted to come through for a true conservative fighter...
**[As a special favor to me, will you rush your support to Doug's campaign...and make sure he has the resources to fight back and win?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61205104:JN42zIVIN:m:1:3331421248:57DB408294FFF61C004916AE44DCC1AB:r)** | | | | [DONATE TO DOUG](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61205105:JN42zIVIN:m:1:3331421248:57DB408294FFF61C004916AE44DCC1AB:r)

Back in 2018, **polls said I would lose by 7%** and the Leftist media had **all but written me off.**

Support from _conservatives like you_ helped prove them wrong...and I'm sure you'd agree: **Florida would be a MUCH worse place today if we had come up short.**
* When the rest of the nation locked down for COVID-19, **Florida empowered our people** and stayed open.

* When the rest of the nation capitulated to the Far-Left on Critical Race Theory and transgender orthodoxy, **Floridians stood with our values and fought back.**

Right now, Pennsylvania voters face the same choices Floridians faced in 2018:

Will we elect a principled conservative leader who will **stand and FIGHT for the values we cherish**...or will we give up and **let the Far-Left finish their takeover** of this great nation?

Floridians decided to take a stand...and America's a better place because we did.

Now, **Doug Mastriano needs your help to make sure Pennsylvanians join us in the nationwide fight for freedom too.**

Doug WILL win this race and be the kind of **fearless conservative ally we need to beat Far-Left radicalism _for good_**...but first, **he needs to have you in his corner.**

**[So I'm asking you, please help Doug's campaign surge in the final 2 months of this race.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61205104:JN42zIVIN:m:1:3331421248:57DB408294FFF61C004916AE44DCC1AB:r)**

This is alarming, but I need you to read:
**Don Bolduc, a far-right extremist running against me, is leading the polls in New Hampshire.**
This isn't just bad news for our Senate majority – it's bad for our democracy.
Bolduc continues to push the Big Lie and baseless election fraud claims and even “promised to defy the presidential election results, should he be called upon to do so in 2024."
And that’s not all—Bolduc says he is open to abolishing the FBI and even recently called to repeal the 17th Amendment, which allows voters to elect their Senators directly.
Don Bolduc's dangerous rhetoric couldn't be more out of touch with Granite State values, and if elected, he would only drag New Hampshire backward.
With everything from reproductive rights (Bolduc said we should “rejoice” at _Roe_ being overturned) to the fate of our planet (he said climate is “not a priority”) on the line, we cannot afford to have Don Bolduc in the United States Senate.

Floridians decided to take a stand...and America's a better place because we did.

Now, **Doug Mastriano needs your help to make sure Pennsylvanians join us in the nationwide fight for freedom too.**

Doug WILL win this race and be the kind of **fearless conservative ally we need to beat Far-Left radicalism _for good_**...but first, **he needs to have you in his corner.**

Peter -
We are one week out from the September 13 primary! On election day, Joy's name will appear 5th on the ballot for RI’s Second District Congressional race. Below are 5 ways you can help support Joy.
5 FOR FOX
1. Go Vote for Joy! [https://vote.sos.ri.gov/Voter/PersonVotingPage]
Go to your city or town hall, or a designated spot, to vote early (up to September 12). Tag us on Facebook [https://facebook.com/joyfoxcongress] , Instagram [https://instagram.com/joyfoxcongress] , or Twitter [https://twitter.com/joyfoxri] to share why you voted for Joy!
If you need a ride to the polls, call us at 401-203-7005.
2 . Volunteer on Election Day [https://forms.gle/UJYMKQbzzeUq6aVE9]
We are looking for volunteers to hold signs at polling stations and give rides to voters!
3. Share Joy's latest press! [https://joyfoxcongress.com/press/]
Joy took part in three Congressional Primary Debates last week! Check out our press page to read and share Joy’s latest news.
4. Donate $10 to support Joy [https://joyfoxcongress.com/donate-to-joy-fox-for-congress/]
Every dollar helps us get out the vote!
5. Put a Joy Fox lawn sign in your yard [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScRXXrQBA_PwA6cpUJWMKNvQ9VInTT0qtMIA72zvasBRDV6VA/viewform?emci=549ffa65-4d13-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=8981722]

We hope you found a new way to get involved with us! With your help, we can elect Joy Fox to Congress this fall.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: This is very close to my heart
body:
Empty template

Dear Peter,

I am writing to you about a matter that's very urgent and
close to my heart.

In June the U.S. Supreme Court issued its decision in the
Dobbs case, restoring the right of Americans like you and me to
protect the most vulnerable and defenseless among us - unborn
children - through the democratic process and uphold the dignity
of women and families. After almost 50 years of court rulings
that unjustly prevented the people and their elected lawmakers
from enacting meaningful protections for unborn human life, this
was a major victory.

We are now at the beginning of a new era. Over the next
few years we will have the opportunity to save hundreds of
thousands, even millions of lives by limiting the horror of
abortion in many places. The overwhelming majority of our fellow
Americans agree that there should be significant limits.

Our faith and science are in harmony on this issue. As a
former pediatric neurosurgeon who performed the first successful
brain surgery on a baby in the womb, I have had the privilege of
witnessing the complexity of unborn life up close. I often
marveled at the advancements in medicine that allowed me to
operate on unborn babies as young as 25 weeks' gestation. Today,
healing surgeries like these are possible as early as 15 weeks.

Seeing the miracle of life firsthand helped convince me
that the unborn are every bit as human and deserving of life as
those of us who survived the womb. They have beating hearts like
us by six weeks, unique fingerprints forming by 10 weeks, and by
15 weeks we can even see them cry when something causes pain.
Each child bears the image of God.

But a powerful lobby is sowing confusion and fear about
what the Dobbs victory means. That extends into our own pews
where, statistically, many of our sisters and brothers are
suffering due to abortion. Politicians allied with this lobby
support abortion on demand, up until the moment of birth - even
brutal late-term abortions when unborn children can feel
excruciating pain. More than ten thousand such abortions occur
every year in our nation. Some of them even want to shut down
pregnancy centers, where people of faith have been on the front
lines loving and serving our neighbors by supporting women and
families for decades.

This November, Americans are blessed to have a chance to
use our voices and decide what kind of nation we want to be going
forward. I pray it will be one that respects the God-given right
to life and holds civic leaders accountable to protect it. It is
especially critical that believers not sit on the sidelines. We
must proclaim the good news of life within our own communities
and rescue those being led away to death. We cannot be afraid to
speak the truth in love about the moral and spiritual battle
taking place for hearts and minds across America.

At the American Cornerstone Institute we believe every
life matters and will always advocate for life and solutions to
help everyone reach a place of dignity as a child of God. I hope
I can count on you in this noble endeavor.

Please take a moment to watch this important video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LU6yHnqNeoM

Dr. Ben Carson

--
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

This work was only possible because we stood together. And friend, it’s become pretty clear that when we build coalitions with unions, organizers, and working people everywhere,WE WIN! This November, so much is at stake. Higher wages in Nebraska, expanded health care in South Dakota, stopping medical debt traps in Arizona, reproductive freedom in Michigan and Vermont, and so much more. To win each of these campaigns, we need every single one of our supporters on board — you too, friend.= = \---------- Forwarded message --------- From:Kelly Hall, Fairness Project (contactus@thefairnessproject.org) Date: Mon, Sept 5, 2022 at 10:15 AM Subject: When working people stand together, we win To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Happy Labor Day, team! This holiday was founded to recognize and celebrate the achievements of working people in America,and it’s a holiday that we at the Fairness Project hold close to our hearts. The Fairness Project was born out of the labor movement, and we’re proud to honor the legacy of union organizers as we use direct democracy to fight for higher wages, better benefits, and economic fairness. You see, friend, direct democracy and the labor movement are deeply connected, because both share an important guiding principle: When working people stand together,we WIN. When we stand together, we win higher wages, better health care, paid medical and family leave, police accountability, reproductive freedom, and so much more. When we stand together, friend, we win social and economic fairness for millions — and THAT is worth celebrating. So today we’re celebrating unions, organizers, and working people everywhere who have led the fight for progress. There are so many lessons we can learn by looking to the history of the labor movement — especially when it comes to building diverse coalitions that are strong enough to withstand attacks and change the status quo. Thanks, team. Have a safe and happy holiday weekend! = Kelly Hall Executive Director Fairness Project P.S. We’re in the final days before the November 2022 election, and higher wages, ending predatory lending practices, expanding health care, and protecting reproductive rights are ALL on the ballot! = Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, our team at the Fairness Project has won 24 people-powered ballot measure campaigns since 2016, changing over 18 million lives by expanding health care, raising wages, guaranteeing paid leave, and ending predatory lending directly at the ballot box when politicians refuse to act. Your support allows us to make this progress possible.** = = Contributions or gifts to the Fairness Project are not deductible as charitable contributions for federal income tax purposes. | Friend,
Last week, I went to Pennsylvania to **campaign for my good friend, Doug Mastriano** , the Republican nominee for Governor of Pennsylvania.
Doug’s a **principled defender of conservative values, liberty, and the American Dream**...and I know that he’ll govern by putting freedom first, just like I do down here in Florida.
Doug’s **down by just 3 points** in the polls, but his opponent has a _ton_ of money to dump into this race, as well as the unified support of Big Tech and the Leftist Media.

| Fix This Mess T.V. Ad is on the Air!
This past week, Vikram Mansharamani released his latest T.V. ad entitled Fix This Mess, highlighting his unique political outsider story.
In a race full of career politicians, the ad celebrates Vikram's business experience. While Vikram's opponents have spent their lives running for office, Vikram has been running businesses.
Vikram states: "As I travel around talking to Granite Staters, one theme remains constant. The career politicians have failed us. None of us feel represented by those who go to Washington more focussed on filling their pockets than representing their neighbors. We need a senator with the real-world experience to give the people of New Hampshire a voice in government."
The ad, the campaign's fourth of the primary, will air through September 13.

name: Pro Life Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhgbjm5iith07t6677mh75esbl088ng9hffg5vno_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o35clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hffdpm6ip7collmpr7ac5im5pjed3i6hj3adplc1in9o75cjge8c3icspj4pb261jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9p6cdb76ko6fdj5coor1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf469qvrv06ehbmnl9cffh51v4l3gpj6srphpq58_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o35clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp3t5cjvu19svr4t3lgkps2vehs1jhkvqjkqf648_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o35clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf4j43s7q7ak7ed6bj2bmajspvcu6b5ghu8it5a8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o35clh2bs)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

I have big news, friend: **With polls showing me 1 point behind my GOP opponent, Herschel Walker, we’re launching TV ads to reach more voters, pull ahead, and win.**

The entire GOP establishment is behind Walker, so keeping this seat blue will come down to getting our people-powered message in front of as many folks as possible. **That's why I'm urgently asking:**[Will you chip in $5 now before our important midnight fundraising deadline to keep our ads on the air so we can defeat Herschel Walker and win in Georgia?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50281519/365307521/-1789705490?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk3836-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWNjYzYxZi1kYzJkLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VXpZxGrkplOyhSbHXM9oyuZ94FMff97dg-I3239m80w=)
Here's why your grassroots donation – _today – _is so critical: After _NPR_ analysts called me one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection, national Republicans started coming after me as their top target for defeat.

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zidg9g14noqsgaqtvavaqfqbp4to3mbn1j6rkcg8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6t9jc6ob2tj3etgj6p5h6hrb7d3568r74d1nc6rjcs3gc4qrdc3gesqjfdj3murt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9p6cdb76ko6fdj6cooj1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhm4ob0s1g66or24no)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zv63upq6ua4r8ksf79srqm199kgdqo768f3cn49o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlpsug31cchqrjt00asai4esu6qak5ddmh3tr7a8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2spl4i62k9tp1i6os0tgurbf990ddci4atbc47o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zv3p7dk1aefi8n7ltibdjob3atuquj06uac1prr8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2rvclio269vbin8fvqoelijv90fr8296rsmf11o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5qn3abacodho0kmcrdtgeo4kk52v779pn5q7g7g_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zk6kjm8j52aft8du0s330oceetfq8bqh9bvlf0oo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5ugqllm1lcuu1kpvfuctcbghsa4dbnccs5ai9j8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "Footer Graphic 1")
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zujf8pl569tro3g64uq11i1padvv1gr8h2lt6bpo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge0o33cdh2bs "Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?")**

**SEP 13, 2022 SPECIAL PRIMARY ELECTION, MISSOURI'S NEW VOTING LAW**
St. Louis City residents,

Election notice cards are in the mail this week for the September 13, 2022 Special Primary Municipal Election to fill President of the Board of Aldermen vacancy. Due to Missouri's new election law, this card is no longer considered a valid form of ID for voting.

| **SEP 13, 2022 SPECIAL PRIMARY MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO FILL PRESIDENT OF THE BOARD OF ALDERMEN VACANCY**
City Election Board will hold Special Municipal Elections on Tuesday, September 13, and Tuesday, November 8, to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Lewis Reed as President of the Board of Aldermen. Under the City’s Municipal Code, a vacancy in the office of the President of the Board is required to be filled for the remainder of the unexpired term, if any, at the next general city or state election held not less than sixty days after the vacancy occurs, which will be on Nov. 8.

Under Ordinance 71410 (Proposition D), however, a special primary election is required to enable anyone who wants to run for the position to do so as a “non-partisan” candidate by submitting a nominating petition containing the signatures of at least 2% of the registered voters who voted in the April 6, 2021 mayoral election (i.e., 1,175 signatures). On Sept. 13, voters will be able to vote for as many candidates as they want, with the two candidates receiving the most votes advancing to the November 8 Special General Municipal Election.

The deadline for submitting nominating petitions is 60 days before the date of the Special Primary Municipal Election, or by the close of business on Friday, July 15. Absentee voting for the September 13 Special Primary Municipal Election will begin on Tuesday, August 2.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=b498a0a442&e=a088917f89). Applicants may also call SBA’s Customer Service Center at (800) 659-2955 or email [disastercustomerservice@sba.gov](mailto:disastercustomerservice@sba.gov) for more information on SBA disaster assistance.

As a non-profit, mail-order pharmacy, Rx Outreach is uniquely positioned to help stop the spread of COVID-19 for people who are quarantined and those who may be afraid to travel outside of their homes to the clinic or pharmacy.

subject: Fwd: NHGOP Unity Breakfast
body:
New Hampshire Republican State Committee

| Derek -- I just wanted to make sure you saw this! **We are only 7 days away from the Republican Primary,** and our party is fired up! But once the primary is over, we all look forward to joining together to support our Republican nominees. name: Great America Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6309%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=tIrMi85olbGh2aCvm%2fy8WQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75102%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5xUwr3X9Ik41stgHI%2fDG%2fA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75103%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DwRi59IaIw%2bEvl4ljaHUnw&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75103%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DwRi59IaIw%2bEvl4ljaHUnw&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---
_107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314_

Fellow Patriot, Xin lỗi - that means sorry in Vietnamese.
Simple words like “sorry” were foreign to me when I came to America.

We were refugees from Communist Vietnam, and this new country was large and unfamiliar - but I knew even as a kid that it was the land of opportunity.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za5a37i3sn8kjr3ac1l26lgu6n3brkch59o36cv8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5gecor2c5h2bs)

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Lexi goes to Washington
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=719%2E5257348%2EDaNj7g ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek, over the holiday break, I was digging through my drawers
to look at some old family photos. And this one was too good to keep to
myself.

In 2002, I brought my daughter Alexa (Lexi for short) to the Capitol with
me for work. She was only four, but already had a better fashion sense
than her dad.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em.7fJa3M&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220906_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=719%2E5257348%2EDaNj7g ][IMG]

Right after this photo was taken, we ran into Nancy Pelosi, who was the
minority whip at the time. “This is Nancy Pelosi,” I explained. “She’s our
whip. If you don’t vote the way she wants, she has a whip.”

“Don’t tell her that,” Nancy said, then got down on her knees so she was
eye level with Alexa and said: “It’s a candy whip. It’s a candy whip.”

(“It’s not a candy whip,” I said to myself.)

Twenty years later, Lexi is working in a talent booking agency in New York
City, focused on media, fashion and branding, and her taste is still far
better than mine. That much has never changed.

What’s also remained the same since this photo is my fight in Congress.
The North Star that has guided me during my time in Congress is what is
best for the next generation.

I also want to make my kids proud of what their father did when he had a
chance to serve.

That’s why I’ve been on the forefront of the fight for our democracy and
protecting the right to vote. The right to vote is foundational — the
right upon which all others rest. Destroy the foundation, and the walls of
our democracy come crumbling down.

It’s why I’ve put so much focus on fighting climate change and making
transformative investments in clean energy and a new green economy. It’s
why I am an original co-sponsor of the Green New Deal. If future
generations don’t have clean air, clean water, or an inhabitable planet,
what’s the point of any of the work we do now?

It’s why I’ve fought for universal health care and for Medicare for All.
Too many Americans fall through the cracks, can’t afford quality health
care, and face bankruptcy to pay for medical bills. It’s obscene,
especially in the wealthiest country in the world.

It’s why I fight for federal student loan forgiveness. Burying our
children with generational debt isn’t sustainable or right. It’s
preventing young people from buying homes, starting families, and living
happy lives. It took me ten years to pay off my student loans, ten years
in which they cost more than my rent. And I was one of the lucky ones.

clean_body: [ ]Adam Schiff for Congress Derek, over the holiday break, I was digging through my drawers to look at some old family photos. And this one was too good to keep to myself. In 2002, I brought my daughter Alexa (Lexi for short) to the Capitol with me for work. She was only four, but already had a better fashion sense than her dad. [ ][IMG] Right after this photo was taken, we ran into Nancy Pelosi, who was the minority whip at the time. “This is Nancy Pelosi,” I explained. “She’s our whip. If you don’t vote the way she wants, she has a whip.” “Don’t tell her that,” Nancy said, then got down on her knees so she was eye level with Alexa and said: “It’s a candy whip. It’s a candy whip.” (“It’s not a candy whip,” I said to myself.) Twenty years later, Lexi is working in a talent booking agency in New York City, focused on media, fashion and branding, and her taste is still far better than mine. That much has never changed. What’s also remained the same since this photo is my fight in Congress. The North Star that has guided me during my time in Congress is what is best for the next generation. I also want to make my kids proud of what their father did when he had a chance to serve. That’s why I’ve been on the forefront of the fight for our democracy and protecting the right to vote. The right to vote is foundational — the right upon which all others rest. Destroy the foundation, and the walls of our democracy come crumbling down. It’s why I’ve put so much focus on fighting climate change and making transformative investments in clean energy and a new green economy. It’s why I am an original co-sponsor of the Green New Deal. If future generations don’t have clean air, clean water, or an inhabitable planet, what’s the point of any of the work we do now? It’s why I’ve fought for universal health care and for Medicare for All. Too many Americans fall through the cracks, can’t afford quality health care, and face bankruptcy to pay for medical bills. It’s obscene, especially in the wealthiest country in the world. It’s why I fight for federal student loan forgiveness. Burying our children with generational debt isn’t sustainable or right. It’s preventing young people from buying homes, starting families, and living happy lives. It took me ten years to pay off my student loans, ten years in which they cost more than my rent. And I was one of the lucky ones. And it’s why I fought so hard to expand the child tax credit, and am fighting to make it permanent. It lifted millions of families out of poverty and cut child poverty in HALF. We have to fight for it. [ ]Derek, it is our obligation to leave the world better for the next generation. And as long I’m in Congress, I’m going to fight like hell to do so. If you’re with me in this mission, join me by pitching in $10, or whatever is meaningful to you. When it comes to emails, I’m probably a lot like you: Every day I get messages like this from campaigns asking for my support.
#
Peter,
When it comes to emails, I’m probably a lot like you: Every day I get messages like this from campaigns asking for my support.
I understand it might be hard to see how one contribution could make a difference to a campaign like ours. That’s why I want to take a minute to explain why your contribution is so important today.
Just last month, we learned who our opponent is. Trump calls him “hardcore-MAGA.” Tucker Carlson called him his “favorite candidate.”And that means the MAGA Right will be doing everything they can to mobilize behind him.
National Republicans have already spent millions attacking me to help him win. Worse still, he’s backed by a big tech billionaire who has spent $15 million to unseat me. Simply put, we’re in for a tough fight — and that’s why your support is so critical right now.
When you make a contribution, that money will immediately be put to work to reach voters across Arizona.
Whether it’s running television ads, sending mailers, or getting out in the field to knock doors, we can’t meet voters where they are without grassroots supporters like you who fuel our campaign.
So, I have to ask:
**[Can you please split a $5 contribution between Dick Durbin and my re-election? **She might not want to talk about these things, but you better believe that I will.**
It’s important that we know who could be representing us. For me, I believe that women deserve reproductive freedom and our democracy shouldn’t be toyed with by far-right extremists.
I’m also proud to have led the charge on passing legislation to reinvigorate our water security, stood up for LGBTQ+ rights, and fought tirelessly to lower costs for Nevada families. This is the type of leader that I am.

clean_body: As we start the month coming off of our end of month fundraising push, I wanted to take a minute to explain why you’re getting so many emails from me. | | | Peter, As we start the month coming off of our end of month fundraising push, I wanted to take a minute to explain why you’re getting so many emails from me. Right now, we’re at the tail end of our campaign. There’s just about two months left until Election Day, and what we do now will determine this race. We need to reach every voter in our district, and that means supplying LOTS of volunteers with handouts, water, and supplies to knock on doors for ours in the hot sun. Asking for money is my least favorite part of running a campaign, trust me. I know things are tight with Joe Biden’s inflation crisis, but we will never get America’s economy working again if we don't win this race and take back the House. It’s up to us to put in the work to build the America we deserve, and I can’t do this alone. Team,
I wanted to take a minute to explain how our strategy has evolved since our launch in 2017. (This might get long, so if you don’t have time to read the whole thing but still want to support our work, please **_[click here to contribute.)](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50288825/365336694/842361994?amount=20&refcode=20220904.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ1NmJiNDM1LWVjMmQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=uEMv0Fd042pUnDTROv7vnXV62vxXe7DY4UqeBPee-9E=)_**
For the past five years, the NDRC has built an effective model for combatting GOP gerrymandering. By starting early, we helped shift the balance of power away from map manipulators, built a robust grassroots network demanding fair maps, and mobilized record-levels of public engagement in the redistricting process, leading to the fairest districts this country has seen in decades.
But redistricting has always been just one piece of the puzzle for protecting our democracy. And as we see a well-funded right wing minority increasingly threatening our democratic system, **we’re applying the same successful model to help safeguard against _both_ the threat of GOP gerrymandering _and_ the anti-democracy forces trying to take hold in the states.**
[It won't happen without your help - will you donate now?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50288826/365336695/842361994?amount=20&refcode=20220904.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ1NmJiNDM1LWVjMmQtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=uEMv0Fd042pUnDTROv7vnXV62vxXe7DY4UqeBPee-9E=)
---
What does this actually mean? It means tactics like:

>> Working in 17 target states to safeguard democracy.
>> Supporting 14 Democracy Defenders running in critical state and local states, so far.
>> Stopping the GOP from corrupting our election administration system.
The races we’re focused on will have an enormous impact on the future of fair redistricting, the freedom to vote, and fair elections. We’re supporting candidates who have defended fair maps, holding Republicans accountable for gerrymandering, and helping elect officials who will block attempts to undermine our elections.
But like all of our work over the past five years, our projects will only be successful with the support of our grassroots community. And with Election Day getting closer and closer we need to know you’re on board so we can plan the next two months of work.
**So team, can A.G. Holder and the NDRC count on you to pitch in today and support our fight to defend our democracy?**

body:
Throughout 2020, groups of armed extremists intimidated and harassed lawmakers and peaceful demonstrators, sometimes provoking violent confrontations.
#

Friends -
Last week, President Biden gave a powerful speech about political violence in this country.
He talked about how those who have “fanned the flames of political violence that are a threat to our personal rights, the pursuit of justice, to the rule of law, to the very soul of this country.”
We’ve spoken about this before:
Throughout 2020, groups of armed extremists intimidated and harassed lawmakers and peaceful demonstrators, sometimes provoking violent confrontations.
These undemocratic displays culminated on January 6, 2021, when insurrectionists stormed the United States Capitol. In the days following the attack, police seized guns, Molotov cocktails, flex cuffs, and hundreds of rounds of ammunition from the rioters.
Let us be clear:
Gun safety laws are integral not only to public safety, but also to our democracy. The right to bear arms must be balanced with other rights like freedom of speech, religion, and assembly.
At Giffords, our Guns & Democracy initiative highlights the risks and tragic outcomes that can result when rights are not balanced with responsibilities.
It also points legislators and the public toward solutions that will help strengthen, not weaken, our democratic institutions.
So if you believe like we do—that armed extremism is a threat to our democracy—we have an important ask:

The cost of pursuing higher education has skyrocketed in recent decades, leading more than half of today’s college graduates to leave school with debt.

**_But now, millions of Americans with student loan debt can breathe a sigh of relief. I applaud President Biden’s decision to cancel up to $20,000 in student loan debt – finally, this long-awaited relief will fundamentally change lives._**

So many have shouldered the weight of student loan debt for too long – many even unable to keep up with interest payments to chip away at the principal owed, leaving them deeper in debt with no end in sight.

20 million Americans will have their student debt forgiven thanks to President Biden’s action – but there are another 20 million who will still be burdened with their student loans. This is no doubt a step in the right direction, but we must keep building on this work.

[We must come together and call for further relief to borrowers everywhere. Add your name right away.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50315785/365402257/1325446311?refcode=JJ_EM_PT_90DO_220906_1_1&refcode2=94199ba2-0f2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&contactdata=5rCg%2FNdnYXtbcf4FkdYreqd3sYzlfNWnzKOpEBRkf6AXVHij%2FG7M6kXct%2F0K5y%2BSdvJgUizgNFoBWyAg6uELQQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDE5OWJhMi0wZjJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hVjH80ga_uOv5I2Wt7Qm7Fj_pIgnIgTCpfxDW636cks=&emci=93199ba2-0f2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=94199ba2-0f2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239)

Americans shouldn’t have to decide between obtaining a college education and a secure financial future.

The prospect of taking on a crushing amount of debt post-graduation is no doubt a deterrent for many Americans considering higher education. And for those who do take on student loans, the debt that follows them acts as a barrier to other long-term financial goals, like buying a home or saving for a family.

**President Biden’s plan to cancel millions’ student debt and enact much-needed changes to loan repayment systems has been a long time coming. But we can’t stop now.**

[Millions of Americans still need relief. Add your name to stand with me and call for additional loan forgiveness!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50315787/365402259/1325446311?refcode=JJ_EM_PT_90DO_220906_1_1&refcode2=94199ba2-0f2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&contactdata=5rCg%2FNdnYXtbcf4FkdYreqd3sYzlfNWnzKOpEBRkf6AXVHij%2FG7M6kXct%2F0K5y%2BSdvJgUizgNFoBWyAg6uELQQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDE5OWJhMi0wZjJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hVjH80ga_uOv5I2Wt7Qm7Fj_pIgnIgTCpfxDW636cks=&emci=93199ba2-0f2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=94199ba2-0f2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239)

body:

---
| | Friend, What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? Joe Biden's been in the basement for months. He pops out - delivers a massively unpopular plan for student loan forgiveness - and goes back to avoiding the public. That peek-a-boo act must be written into the official Democrat playbook because my opponent, Katie Hobbs, is doing the exact same thing! She refuses to debate. She refuses to show her face to the people of Arizona. If she's not making a plea to the radical left for more Soros money to fund her campaign, no one hears from her at all. This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zr0ii7i4rgteh3rv1ngfpsij4ghdlscu2mjtbga0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That’s because**I’M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... The failing establishment elites are closed doors.
It’s time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhqni453m9adg7k4aiicmn5vc00ud1k664v9559g_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zql73bg9pp1je33v5er13crnvr7eoob9nq4ku1u0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I’m the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmrg826dbk6cr1dv1gfidlhhg60fvlkkgod7js1o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)
---
Together, we’re going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there’s a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I’ve always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that’s not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z23op5g1puk3hdndquua8pe1gmnejhrb3e6la57g_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had — that’s what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that “BDE” that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me “Kari, you’re going to be the DeSantis of the West.” Other than being called “Trump in a Dress — which is my favorite compliment of all — that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you’re going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5l0ctfnlhn90m97e24kmrjof5r5ae19ddqo2p30_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)
---
**Friend, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden’s ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Friend, let’s not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country.** ** It’s our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay.** ** And it’s our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track.** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona!** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It’s game time.** ** And I need you on my side.** ** **_[Will you support our momentum?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zetq8egmlvjg080tdjp6dotvqp5ebgq7a52rdll0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)___**
---
Now, I don’t care if you’re with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America. ](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zgatpmklvdrglp20vnml3r9b1k4klgnhdnuvslq8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)_** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjnrobhnge46p4ge6nr2be2qsalakor2i3g9f36o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ge1o70clh2bs)
---
Sincerely,
---

This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can't afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President's home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that 's exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61199982:J1HXSIVN1:m:1:3339843426:39794D6C3D6B294168D3EC306311A7B7:r) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you ... ** **[Will you chip in before it's to help ensure our efforts can continue?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61199982:J1HXSIVN1:m:1:3339843426:39794D6C3D6B294168D3EC306311A7B7:r)**[ ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61199982:J1HXSIVN1:m:1:3339843426:39794D6C3D6B294168D3EC306311A7B7:r) Let me back up. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. Peter,

As a first-generation immigrant, a father of six, and a man of faith, I'm here to tell you: [**It doesn't have to be this way.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208137:JTLb4IVqN:m:1:3253819041:9779D2BC1F04C83799A4C019B6908E77:r)

name: Kristina Karamo
subject: The Necessity of Accurate Voter Rolls
body:
**SoS Benson 's War on Accurate Voter Rolls, the Bedrock of Election Accuracy**
As I campaign throughout Michigan, one of the most common complaints I hear regards illegal registrations. People tell me all kinds of stories, like "I received a voter ID for this person, and they haven't lived here in over 25 years." Or, "My wife received an absentee ballot application and she is not a U.S. citizen." Or even, "My wife's sister received an absentee ballot application under my wife's maiden name, even though she never lived there, and we've been married for over 20 years." How can a woman be registered to vote at an address where she has never lived -- and in her maiden name?
The examples go on and on. People's stories expose a very sinister reality: that the voter registration database is intentionally corrupt. Ongoing litigation has revealed that SoS Benson has not been accurately maintaining the voter rolls (by failing to remove deceased voters, for example), is stone-walling citizen oversight of her maintenance procedures and is simply issuing false proclamations that she is following the law. **A March 2022 report released by the Michigan Auditor General found that Benson was not reconciling the voter registration database with the driver 's license file, which she is required by law to do.**
A person should not be able to cast a ballot unless they are registered to vote. Registration is required so election officials can ensure that the person is legally qualified to vote, that the person casting the ballot is actually the individual legally qualified, and that the person can only vote once. Illegal ballots need either a fraudulent registration or an individual engaged in identity theft by voting under another person's name.
Voting under another person's name is risky unless the thief knows something regarding the person, such as that the voter is incapacitated, that ensures them the voter won't try to vote. However, there are multiple reports of people going to the polls only to be informed that they already voted absentee.
Demanding accurate voter rolls is not partisan. It is about protecting our voting rights, which consist of three elements: ballot access, ballot security, and illegal ballot prevention. Every illegal vote nullifies a legal vote. Corruption in our election system is a national security threat because voting is the only way that we, the people, maintain control over our government.
Elections can quickly change the direction of a nation. Why wouldn't enemies, foreign or domestic, want to exploit vulnerabilities and corruption in our election system? By corrupting elections, a nation could overthrow their enemy without firing a single shot. **Protecting our voting rights by purging the corruption from our elections is a matter of national survival.**
Help me clean up the voter rolls by making a contribution to my campaign today.

Dear Peter,
My name is Courtney Geels, and I have been nursing at the bedside for about 10 years, mostly in the Emergency Room. One thing I've learned over the years is that our medical system is broken. I can no longer effectively advocate for patients in the clinical setting as hospital administrations are making decisions that prioritize profits over quality.

These decisions are dictated by Medicaid and Medicare because the federal government pays around 70% of hospital revenue. Politicians in Washington decide regulations and reimbursement. So when you sit down with your doctor, it's really a discussion between you, your doctor, and the federal government.

That is not okay.
