Friends and Partners,We have been a little quiet the last couple of months as we pressed into the vision for the next season of our lives. It has certainly been a unique experience to give everything that you have and to come up short.
Some may see this as a loss, but we still see it as a victory. We originally ran against 15 competitors in my very first political race. We were elbowed out by an establishment candidate, but not before we showed the Nation that a grassroots candidate with zero political backing, experience, know-how, and finances could stir up the waters in a blue state.
We started with a few people showing up to meetings and within months we had thousands showing up to events. We ended up with close to every endorsement you could get outside of the GOP, but in the end politics is politics and cash is still King.
If we would have raised another 50K I think we would have taken the primary.
Moving forward!
Saturday October 1st our team will be hosting a beautiful backyard cookout in Rancho Palos Verdes to celebrate our victory and our gratitude for your support and love along the way.
Come hang out with influential people in this moment in time. Mover and shakers, those that hold office, people running now and in the future.

Democrats like Roy Cooper and President Biden know that climate change is an existential risk to this planet. That’s why Roy has repeatedly taken bold action to commit North Carolina to a clean energy future, and why President Biden and Democrats in D.C. recently passed the most aggressive legislation ever to combat climate change.
But too many in the GOP would rather sweep the issue under the rug. They continue to pretend that climate change isn’t a real problem (or even worse, that it’s a hoax). They even tried to block President Biden’s key legislation in a bare-faced political ploy. **Republicans would rather stay on the good side of the Big Oil lobby than protect our planet’s future.**
Peter, climate change is not something that we can afford to ignore.

name: Dr. Norman Horn
subject: Join Us: Christians against Big Government
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208658:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)
Peter,

You know what makes me furious? When leftwing activists claim Jesus Christ would support socialism, student loan bailouts, or a big government.

And to make things worse?

Most of the time, these leftwingers don't believe in Jesus. They're simply _weaponizing Christianity to justify their political beliefs_.

Here's the thing: I don't care if the attack comes from the left or the right. If somebody uses the name of God to justify aggression, I'm going to stand against it. What are you going to do?

**My name is Dr. Norman Horn, I founded the Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) with the mission to make the Christian case for free markets and free people.**

Christians are an integral part of defending liberty, preserving morality in our culture, and opposing the evils of empires.

In the words of Benjamin Franklin, _" Rebellion to Tyrants is Obedience to God."_ More importantly, we should heed the words of Acts 5:29, "We ought to obey God rather than men."

You and I are responsible for making the Christian case for liberty to our fellow believers, non-believers, and countrymen. The Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) is leading this cause and equipping Christians the knowledge, resources, and courage to execute on this mission.

[_**Please join the Libertarian Christian Institute by making a donation of any amount. My goal is to raise $10,000 from online supporters to spread our message of Faith and Freedom. Please click here or below to donate:**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208658:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208659:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)

[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208664:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208665:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208658:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)

The Libertarian Christian Institute believes liberty is the most consistent expression of Christian political thought.

**This is what we believe and are fighting for: **
* Christians must root their beliefs in Scripture.

* A free society must abide by a Non-Aggression principle - The Bible gives us clear instructions to reject violence and force to change hearts and minds. This applies to the government as well.

* Individual liberty is critical to achieving peace and prosperity.

* Healthy social institutions matter for human flourishing - Meaning we must not surrender our schools, churches, or even businesses to Woke social justice activists and the enemies of liberty.

* Christian theology affirms the ideas of free market capitalism: Jesus instructs us to respect each other's property, to never STEAL from our neighbor, and to be productive citizens.

God has given us everything we need to make the _Christian_ case for a free society.

However, I fear our country will continue falling into the grasp of socialism if you and I fail to advocate for our ideas and the values laid out for us in Scripture.

[_**Peter, I am calling on you to help me spread our message and begin changing the hearts and minds of both believers and non-believers with our mission. Please support the Libertarian Christian Institute by clicking here to make a donation. **_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208658:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)

How do we spread the _Christian_ message of free markets, free people, and a free society?

Here is everything the Libertarian Christian Institute is doing to have an impact:

* **The Libertarian Christian Institute Podcast:** We produce a weekly podcast reaching THOUSANDS of people across the country. We discuss current events and tackle the Christian perspective on things such as School Choice, student loans, Sound Money, and the pro-life movement.

* **Our book, "Faith Seeking Freedom: Libertarian Christian Answers To Tough Questions":** We've published a book to make the Christian case on all the difficult debates of the modern day... Why abortion is evil, why taxation is theft, and why believers must reject socialism.

* **Online Content & Events:** Our belief is that we must reach NEW audiences and folks who may not agree with us on everything. We desire to change hearts and minds... not preach to the choir. LCI publishes online content constantly and presents at conferences in order to reach people with our message.

Here's the big problem with all of this...

I can't spread our message without your help.

**The battle for liberty and my faith in Jesus Christ represent a merger of two of the most important things in my life. I am a Christian with a heart on fire wanting to spread both the Gospel and the message of liberty. **

The Libertarian Christian Institute does not have billionaires funding our operations... I am counting on the support of believers from across the country donating online.

Please help me reach my goal of raising $10,000 so LCI can continue spreading our message.

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61208659:6Upa5IVNR:m:1:3253819041:45C70686174669B2EA76A08A33905481:r)

Thank you so much, Peter.

It would mean the world to me if I earned your support for LCI's mission today.

Let's make the Christian case for a free society together.

Dr. Norman Horn
President
Libertarian Christian Institute

subject: the greatest joy of my life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
That's who I raised my kids to be – fierce, fearless, and independent. In other words, Missourians.
| | |
---
Peter, the greatest joy and honor of my life has been being a mother.
One of the parts of motherhood that always makes me so proud – and often brings a tear to my eye – is watching my kids do things that they weren't sure they could do. All of my children are fierce, and none of them take kindly to being underestimated. My heart just soars when I see them meet a challenge with a fire in their belly and take any obstacle head-on.
**That's who I raised my kids to be – fierce, fearless, and independent. In other words, Missourians.**
The people of Missouri are tough. We love to prove the naysayers wrong, and we'll fiercely take on anything that stands in our way or threatens the people we love. That's the type of person I raised my kids to be – just like my parents raised me.
You see, my family has lived here for many generations. We're Missourians through and through. I know this state and these communities like the back of my hand. **That’s why when Washington, D.C., insiders claim that Missouri can't be flipped, I say, "You don't know this state like I do."**
**I know my state is ready to reject power-hungry career politicians who want to force their way into our exam rooms, undermine our democracy, and deny families their shot at their American Dream.** Missourians are ready for compassionate, tough, and honest leadership. I see it at every whistle-stop, every meet and greet, and every parade.
Trust me on this: Missourians are going to prove the naysayers wrong on Election Day. **We're going to embrace kindness, integrity, a dedication to real change, and everything that makes us so proud to be from the Show Me State.**

**_That must be why I'm number one on their hit list._**

Over the past few years, liberals locked down citizens, destroyed the economy and did an unknown amount of damage to the physical and mental health of their communities...

But I kept Florida **_FREE._**

I stood up to the big government, anti-science lies throughout the COVID pandemic. I kept our businesses open and our kids in school. I kept the woke agenda OUT. As a result, Florida is thriving.

And the fake news just can't take it. [**FIGHT THE FAKE NEWS >>**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ebaf731d4f4a4249a821c655ce9bd085&_e=-dAoYif-leykhGzCBn_LlfVcneMLYR24C5DqaEte6ngj-jsDORrD5stD1PTkfZaDZQOTyVA7bu5qwn9ODhF2SdCgkEzXtJZibC6UkCuynMl5Ucep9bUGflggSiw08hpn0_kfTE5tg7GQzQ1_lGjrX7t9R-yHsyqcCEtB2uuLPCWRVhAzJvn-sh5ZWCup_0HFfrONkEs8voXpVBD8zx3rBqky1RHZhdVqhstm2jOR-Lm5iPEIRyPrRMj926p_C1fkiu88rGaULpQ-qXiPdy0cfSsxCYn1NcPT4tWfzEysO6lqi8QA5_3m50EdL4a3e0WSZJzhurVWPiaFcYEVISyaNnpR1a8jXY6nn0_wkc1PMMQ%3D)

They try to stir the pot on books, free speech, and our COVID policies – going so far as to call us a “death cult.”

** _But all of it is a lie!_** While liberal states like California work to rewrite history to fit their oppressive narratives, Florida has empowered students to LEARN in the classroom. We've given parents a voice to advocate for their children. And despite all of the upset, Florida's response to COVID has been more successful than the heavy lockdown states like Michigan and New Jersey.
**_You won't see it on TV, but that's THE TRUTH._**

**To me, the truth still matters.** And I will always defend the truth, even if it is unpopular to do so or goes against the "mainstream."

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9f2aef978bd340beb7d129fca7541e34&_e=JE4cPx0j3a6jEVuF8w9ZaByE0Y6twVIQxZvtgXm8CuojhmKPthrdlUA6qzoB_b0Sqy7Am6pqgeztSgk7eypLE4sUMAHxSLrnsg0XKCpcYQ43gr57HyL809iqwh6PeRsQejlpBhEqQmUAHDhkueZnSa2Wy7UBU-ryvDJ_Y_r-rSF7VxVqeLNxkmfBM7EwGaYVEJuKaOyuwA5VMIEla3dBbu-rb8M1-YscitV3pnqHptQ3iclkbpwgM6fO2dlCOpWCPJWVI1-QwP1x5VOSdEikP4mlnCYOxUvMF1HE5zH4aajU462olvcDzeu7g5zvx-YFoIRKU0IulhozM01ZgFU-3mIhZSp9mpNlEWWMb1vU3JzZldKhqa1oiYVKExZGaQ36j2mu6fVt9jPtjIQj7DgxcYEpDn9czfZ4YCS78gUyq_w%3D "Johnson1")**_

Did you see Betsy’s recent op-ed in The Oregonian where she laid out why she’s running and what she’ll do as Oregon’s truly independent governor? Check out the full piece in the link below to see how Betsy will put the people back in charge and be a governor for ALL Oregonians! | [](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/r?u=cNAjSoJ9gnO_hunUGXS9Yp3TKQ6IduTMzJka0KUDXKAkHdSzXnUoEQCBathbKVulvpgBll6KcIL6k3f81MuXIAhq0Hb3ls9FAo4tRqTimdoiixsOG25bkWnfOi8qagpZS0_Ay_hU9Te0O7eGGtHA3OuuTBMZ5LqS7GOzOURhBVjgZudZrManFYIkitB-zwvYZYdi4Rz8_Ov-GSnP_uR92E0Ej_bwEenZ0BTILay3hso&e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news_2&n=2 "READ BETSY'S OP-ED") [READ BETSY'S OP-ED](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/r?u=cNAjSoJ9gnO_hunUGXS9Yp3TKQ6IduTMzJka0KUDXKAkHdSzXnUoEQCBathbKVulvpgBll6KcIL6k3f81MuXIAhq0Hb3ls9FAo4tRqTimdoiixsOG25bkWnfOi8qagpZS0_Ay_hU9Te0O7eGGtHA3OuuTBMZ5LqS7GOzOURhBVjgZudZrManFYIkitB-zwvYZYdi4Rz8_Ov-GSnP_uR92E0Ej_bwEenZ0BTILay3hso&e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news_2&n=2)
---
* * *
### **Betsy Unveils Unprecedented Law Enforcement Coalition **
On Thursday, Betsy announced that an unprecedented 90 law enforcement leaders and victims’ rights advocates have endorsed her campaign for governor. These leaders know that Betsy has always had the backs of law enforcement and crime victims and that, as governor, she will remain committed to putting the needs of crime victims over criminals. The full list of endorsements from Betsy’s Law and Order Coalition can be [found here](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/law_and_order_coalition?e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news_2&n=3).
* * *
### **New Ad Alert! **
Did you see Betsy’s new ad that went live this week? We shouldn’t be forced to pick between our fundamental rights and our personal safety. Betsy will protect them both.
[](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/watch_the_latest_ad_both?e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news_2&n=4)
* * *
### **11 th Beers with Betsy Draws Crowd in The Dalles**
Thanks to everyone who joined Betsy in the beautiful Columbia River Gorge for her 11th Beers with Betsy to talk water, affordability, and a woman’s right to choose. As Oregon’s independent governor, Betsy is committed to protecting and defending all three.
****
* * *
### **Betsy Outlines Law and Order Agenda **
On Thursday, while announcing unprecedented support from 90 law enforcement leaders and victims’ rights advocates, Betsy unveiled her law and order agenda, which includes:
* * Repealing Ballot Measure 110 – the failed experiment to legalize hard drugs.
* Appointing a single leader to coordinate local, state and federal resources to combat drug cartels, gangs and the flow of illegal drugs like fentanyl into Oregon, especially in southern Oregon.
* Replacing the entire Kate Brown parole board.
* Ending the early release of criminals from state prisons.
* Reinstating an Oregon State Police presence in Portland and reactivating Portland’s gang intervention unit.
* Reinstating mandatory minimum sentences for murderers and sex offenders of any age.
* Strengthening efforts with local law enforcement and DAs to ensure people who commit theft crimes are investigated, arrested, and prosecuted.

[](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZEWmakAxvz52fTQ_rJRtL0&e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news_2&n=5)
* * *
### **Betsy Brigade in the Dairy Barn!**
Our dairy farmer friends were told they had to take down their Betsy signs at the state fair, so we sent them some swag they could proudly display wherever they go! Way to bring your Betsy pride to the dairy barn!
[DONATE TODAY](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4wuZ-2t-UfLCO31ykNad3IpZEmWqyffPUGUGo7kVPPkAacKZ6St4NkcRw7yA3_kaaev4PDh1EwuXhL1GRA-paClCV-vWPMLFjPfqQYlcKQEpBbrMQBTMuoft8RJFE9mVA&e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news_2&n=6)

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zti6ckr91riaib1hrk9khjr0hbn6bqpi7t64njt0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ieep30slh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbob8oljmeq6fcr3c1pn1dhmcup6adtmmerj2ttk6ipmbdb66qqr4pjn65h30o70sv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664ob6oj0etjmcc5n6kq3fc5lclp2bs)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zo5rnf7l27lk3v8f5ga356cbmr1so9mvdfi60ic8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ieep30slh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---
| |
* * *
A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8okj1nimrgp534dcskitd9trroq2armnrafm7f8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c5ieep30slh2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

body:
I’m a lifelong Michigander who is focused on getting things done that will make a difference in people’s lives | Hi friend, it’s Gretchen Whitmer, Michigan’s 49th governor, and I’m reaching out to Wes’ biggest supporters to tell you a bit about myself. [**Before I begin, I’m up for a tough fight this election, and I’m asking you to contribute $10 to help me win this race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50315436/365401014/-1033325493?refcode=wesmoore&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODZmNjA5OC0wZTJlLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=63fMeaY0Ts1h0ZOHWgpnPfP3GLTtb3jF-nWUXXxqjEw=) I’m a lifelong Michigander who is focused on getting things done that will make a difference in people’s lives. I’m an attorney, an educator, former prosecutor, State Representative, and Senator. **But the most important title I boast is mom.** Both my daughters, Sherry and Sydney, are students at the University of Michigan, and my three stepsons, Alex, Mason, and Winston all live in Michigan as well. And we can’t forget about our favorite First Dogs of Michigan Kevin and Doug! Inspired by my family, I've devoted my life to building a stronger Michigan for all and governed through unprecedented, colliding crises – remaining focused on doing the right things for the people of Michigan. Unprecedented times call for unprecedented, strong leadership, and right now, we need strong leaders across the country to move us forward. body:
“When you're standing on this line, you're not just asking for $1, you are asking for transformational change.”
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=ocasio-campaign.krJqR8&refcode=em20220906-3362-P_ORG_EXP_LAB&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3362%2E2526796%2EEdvQQl)
In honor of Labor Week, we want to share with you the story of the Hunts Point Workers’ strike and what we can learn from it.
In case you didn’t know, The Bronx is home to Hunts Point Market, the largest wholesale produce market in the country that provides more than half the fruits and vegetables to New York City.
After working tirelessly during the pandemic – putting themselves and their families at risk to feed New Yorkers – they asked for a $1 per hour raise and were denied.
So in January 2021, more than 1,400 workers represented by the Teamsters Local 202 union united together on the picket line after voting to strike. Hundreds of workers walked off the job for the first time in over three decades.
Alexandria skipped the inaugural festivities to instead join workers on the picket line. She said to the crowd:
_“When you're standing on this line, you're not just asking for $1, you are asking for transformational change for your lives, and for the lives of every food worker across this country, for kids of food workers across the country._
_Because there's a lot of things upside down right now in our economy. And one of those things that’s upside down is the fact that a person who is helping get the food to your table cannot feed their own kid. That's upside down._
_We need you and we’ve got to pay you like we need you. Because we do. You are not replaceable, you are not expendable, you are valuable. It’s the solidarity of our actions that are going to get us through. It is sticking together.”_
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/4255?t=2&akid=3362%2E2526796%2EEdvQQl)
At first, management refused to budge. A corporation that enjoyed millions in PPP loans and tax giveaways was fighting a $1 raise for essential workers who risked their lives to feed us.
But then, on the seventh day of their walkout, the union won – ratifying a new three-year contract with the biggest pay increase in over 30 years.1
This example proves just how powerful it is when workers join together to fight for their rights. **Knowing when and how to organize your co-workers can be a daunting task, but we’re here to help.**
[**If you’re interested in learning how to organize your workplace, click here for a list of tips, resources, and virtual trainings to help you get started in formulating a strategy and winning.**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/4255?t=3&akid=3362%2E2526796%2EEdvQQl)
Thank you so much for reading and stay tuned for more emails as part of our Labor Week series.
Happy organizing,
Team AOC
P.S. To watch Alexandria’s full remarks on the picket line, [**click here**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14873?t=4&akid=3362%2E2526796%2EEdvQQl).
1 - [New York Times](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14874?t=5&akid=3362%2E2526796%2EEdvQQl)

With just 62 days until Election Day, we don’t have a minute to waste, Derek.
**[Will you rush a donation of any amount right now to help us fight back against the lies Trump and Oz promoted at their MAGA rally?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220906-1?refcode=em20220906-7148&refcode2=7148_434096_1HT0Q-&akid=7148%2E434096%2E1HT0Q-)**

---
| | Dear Fellow American, You've probably noticed the spread of anti-American ideology into every area of American life.
---
| | Consider the 2019 controversy surrounding the Betsy Ross flag. Even though this was three years ago, you still may have heard of it. Shortly before Independence Day, Nike announced its plans to release an athletic shoe featuring the Betsy Ross flag. Then Nike spokesman Colin Kaepernick objected, condemning the flag as a symbol of racism and slavery.

You won't be surprised to learn that a social media storm followed, with Nike announcing that it was halting the production of the shoe.
---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z1nudpeqs5fhfrgm4oq84uu95ngb83069vae4pmo_rp22sh2s8i66or2clg68or1c5h2bs)
---
| | The Kaepernick episode illustrates the problem of progressive education, which seeks to rewrite our nation's history, and undermine the kind of informed patriotism essential to preserving liberty.

Now that you know what a few others think of the Betsy Ross flag...

...I hope you will give us your thoughts about the teaching of American history, including the American Revolution and the Declaration of Independence, by taking a short survey.

Just follow this link to share your opinion:

_[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/betsy-ross-flag-survey/](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4v0nuilms8dvglkn2s8ldt60k44n4ikuunt29gg_rp22sh2s8i66or2clg68or1c5h2bs)_

Like the frenzy for tearing down statues that we witnessed in cities not long ago, the Nike shoe controversy is the bitter fruit of the progressive educational agenda.

I hope I can count on you to help us confront this destructive ideology with the truth about American history.

Please share your thoughts with us today!

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Brenda Siegel
subject: 🌏Climate Can Not Wait🌏
body:
| |
---
There is finally rain after months of drought. The rain is a sound I almost can't remember hearing this summer. **** It’s clear that right now we need Bold Climate Action and if we don’t act soon it may be too late. Sadly, Vermont hasn’t done enough as a state to protect the earth and our climate and that is because we have a Governor putting sticks in the spokes of progress. **** Just this year, the Governor vetoed a number of bills that would have helped move us closer to our climate goals including both the comprehensive Clean Heat Standard and some necessary changes to Act 250. He has called the Global Warming Solutions Act unconstitutional, then appointed a Republican Attorney General who agreed with his radical view. **** With the disastrous effects of the Climate Crisis growing worse each year, we can’t afford to move forward with a Governor that vetoes all of our most important climate legislation. **** I have received endorsements from the three biggest grassroots environmental groups in the state. Vermont Conservation Voters, Sierra Club Vermont and VPIRG Votes have all endorsed our campaign because they know that we will prioritize Bold Climate Action. **** As Governor I will work collaboratively with legislators, advocates, climate scientists, within my administration, and with all of you to ensure that we are taking bold climate action that will also create economic opportunities for struggling Vermonters. We have a responsibility to create a state that our children and the earth can thrive in. **** Currently, we get most of our energy from out of state. This is bad for our state economy and our climate. I’m going to lead a transition to more in-state renewable energy. Governor Scott’s Public Utilities Commission has failed to prioritize protecting the climate. I will appoint climate champions to the Public Utilities Commission. We can simultaneously create economic opportunities and fight climate change. **** We must: ✔️Build robust in state renewable energy. ✔️Put the right people on the Public Utilities Commission. ✔️Increase Public transportation which is good for the environment while also helping aging Vermonters and low-income communities. ✔️Make sure that low- and moderate-income people can access electric vehicles, solar energy and heat pumps. ✔️Support small farms to transition to carbon sequestration and require large farms to do the same. ✔️And so much more. We can't keep standing still when it comes to fighting climate change. We need meaningful climate action now. clean_body: | | There is finally rain after months of drought. The rain is a sound I almost can't remember hearing this summer. ** It’s clear that right now we need Bold Climate Action and if we don’t act soon it may be too late. Sadly, Vermont hasn’t done enough as a state to protect the earth and our climate and that is because we have a Governor putting sticks in the spokes of progress. Just this year, the Governor vetoed a number of bills that would have helped move us closer to our climate goals including both the comprehensive Clean Heat Standard and some necessary changes to Act 250. He has called the Global Warming Solutions Act unconstitutional, then appointed a Republican Attorney General who agreed with his radical view. With the disastrous effects of the Climate Crisis growing worse each year, we can’t afford to move forward with a Governor that vetoes all of our most important climate legislation. I have received endorsements from the three biggest grassroots environmental groups in the state. Vermont Conservation Voters, Sierra Club Vermont and VPIRG Votes have all endorsed our campaign because they know that we will prioritize Bold Climate Action. As Governor I will work collaboratively with legislators, advocates, climate scientists, within my administration, and with all of you to ensure that we are taking bold climate action that will also create economic opportunities for struggling Vermonters. We have a responsibility to create a state that our children and the earth can thrive in. Currently, we get most of our energy from out of state. This is bad for our state economy and our climate. I’m going to lead a transition to more in-state renewable energy. Governor Scott’s Public Utilities Commission has failed to prioritize protecting the climate. I will appoint climate champions to the Public Utilities Commission. We can simultaneously create economic opportunities and fight climate change. ** We must: ✔️Build robust in state renewable energy. ✔️Put the right people on the Public Utilities Commission. ✔️Increase Public transportation which is good for the environment while also helping aging Vermonters and low-income communities. ✔️Make sure that low- and moderate-income people can access electric vehicles, solar energy and heat pumps. ✔️Support small farms to transition to carbon sequestration and require large farms to do the same. ✔️And so much more. We can't keep standing still when it comes to fighting climate change. We need meaningful climate action now. clean_body: It’s an attack on the democratic process, pure and simple. | | | I want to talk about what’s happening in Michigan right now: an attack on the democratic process. A coalition called Reproductive Freedom for All collected a record number of signatures for a ballot measure that would amend the state’s constitution to affirm every person’s fundamental right to reproductive freedom. Recent polling showed strong support. The state’s Bureau of Elections verified that advocates had collected enough valid signatures and recommended that the state Board of Canvassers put it on the ballot this fall. But now two GOP members of that board have blocked it. Reproductive Freedom for All is taking the case to the Michigan state supreme court, but they’re just days away from the ballot-printing deadline — and they could use our help to handle this latest curveball and keep up the fight. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Right after the Supreme Court overturned Roe and sent abortion rights decisions to the states, this team got in the fight supporting a pro-abortion rights campaign in Kansas and Reproductive Freedom for All in Michigan. As we all saw, the people of Kansas sent a clear message and defended abortion access in a landslide. And over 730,000 Michiganders signed the petition to put reproductive freedom on the ballot — which could be a blueprint for many other states trying to affirm abortion protections. But now a couple of Republican officials want to disenfranchise all those voters — and deny the people’s ability to decide this issue — all because of an alleged spacing issue with how the ballot measure is printed. Talk about a flimsy pretext. And talk about a transparent attempt to thwart the democratic process. Because here’s the way I see it: right-wing extremists know that they don’t have the people on their side. They know that most Americans believe people should be able to make decisions about abortion without inteference from politicians or government agents. And if we can make sure this measure gets on the ballot, Michigan voters will have the opportunity to secure reproductive freedom in the state constitution. body:
The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough o The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us.

| [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=4fc247be93d048a3b9b8fdcef26436e0&_e=5q49xGL0UUO6IRyMkAKJZA5P83GFznqQdLy2Mg0NSnovO1NPvrSIigUzT8qGrk9TXTDGFKOfnzGNdOUqK_JFoNdtyMa0ppzFG7VLwspiY9A84egIDIMpWzKoDkda7Tzcbfe5XQ9F9LOg8P6Yk-smH8QMXPLZfwqQzAYssTn-qHf-Al1flh317o_To5ls3ukB4Ic_Vm7Gb-yD78H7Su-awWS_6_2hoMpuLMqtv94Enr_6nAyI-rU6oLK9YEorMnbdmt-Hhvq-IHRsTlEHyuzbZaSFMqzdZE5fei7YfB_bl-gMmLJO2b-MkOZcLMnfjQ7y)
---

Peter,

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us.**

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden’s dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I’m asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=4fc247be93d048a3b9b8fdcef26436e0&_e=5q49xGL0UUO6IRyMkAKJZA5P83GFznqQdLy2Mg0NSnovO1NPvrSIigUzT8qGrk9TXTDGFKOfnzGNdOUqK_JFoNdtyMa0ppzFG7VLwspiY9A84egIDIMpWzKoDkda7Tzcbfe5XQ9F9LOg8P6Yk-smHytBKxKA7Y0fhVanTEVrsBqIq5Ny806R5YsV--MrbmEAf7LC7DI1iVyAjBzB4t9wU1gHtqTTmsSJDbRgw3kdWL_aNgEbk3CL8O2sDenVSUvag6nqM991r6_6dgQb3lj97IiTxPr-pLPHr9oiaZlvzuUuVDx7XJKmh9v9rXAfDajP)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY ➞ **](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=4fc247be93d048a3b9b8fdcef26436e0&_e=5q49xGL0UUO6IRyMkAKJZA5P83GFznqQdLy2Mg0NSnovO1NPvrSIigUzT8qGrk9TXTDGFKOfnzGNdOUqK_JFoNdtyMa0ppzFG7VLwspiY9A84egIDIMpWzKoDkda7Tzcbfe5XQ9F9LOg8P6Yk-smHzmfCk-3HpY89MjqlzWZUtXpwQ5jvjAL1FFhoy66pOdhonPF4NR9It4oxDT0nEccORRzyoIA_DCjJBbZiPrwFQTWyTbL-gZp6_tvrB_B4ckM8KGc26oLWLflZlzTe4nOuI-3junGPV6OBlCIR_0ELYQroZD9mmBg7amXV3Eackb3)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it’s just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It’s about more freedom vs. more government control. **It’s about whether we serve the government ... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

body:

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f22d9e2bcc5f4642acdb4f9ba61fc333&_e=mUunVKyIXaMfurIioTRA1rvy59fsKfNv5bGi6bQ9Xg27p0dCYJxKp_10ly62nVDmggIdAWEs1qJw6LwgBJGIiC3D3Tuigzzd5_Ud1n8EsyQzn99ihQlEA85TrfbjoCn_bvAnIvAHkzO_Dm_M514DbA925_8LIG74vMFRaRshc07Hhl1Pnrzv55FFSd9TlyO7nA2CGGz0cmaMdFT92sI0eAhfPFivf06k4JLXM9vaZEONwmmCpHxTDsqeDWX2DIXQyxkDl-ygQNZyjF9ec1qwYW3jQrhoMPZJVlMDJ17dAC6zzVoFeecBksq7m_1UT782J_az3EwdLdqWgtShO-bn7vRMTdEcMZGc7sZO8CeClO0WSyugLuYQhRlefzFdAnSn8S9wY9DBp-03OK-r4ZlNvx2VesRbAQlBYSbO0_dWsQU%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f22d9e2bcc5f4642acdb4f9ba61fc333&_e=mUunVKyIXaMfurIioTRA1rvy59fsKfNv5bGi6bQ9Xg27p0dCYJxKp_10ly62nVDmggIdAWEs1qJw6LwgBJGIiC3D3Tuigzzd5_Ud1n8EsyQzn99ihQlEA85TrfbjoCn_bvAnIvAHkzO_Dm_M514DbA925_8LIG74vMFRaRshc07Hhl1Pnrzv55FFSd9TlyO7nA2CGGz0cmaMdFT92sI0eAhfPFivf06k4JLXM9vaZEONwmmCpHxTDsqeDWX2DIXQ_LPkihQQAJqDnDmvTeKKJNAhgSnKJRQWsbYMF9UxiCinj3EiAVK8CPQ4LesC84VWbp_whYbOhdTf5GxXxA0yTfropE26OQQHHFwkdDPY4WBTZY8pno4thu2ar0KBob4iWQLiDOnZAThx_3tChdqTkFXcHMs9yFWNsPzTEgaRiBI%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." ** Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

# On the Issues - Energy Policy
In just 2 short years, ideological extremism has taken us from energy independence to energy dependence, resulting in devastating inflation, and leaving our nation’s security and economic well-being in the hands of those who wish to do us harm.As the election approaches, we have been lulled into thinking that gas falling under $4.00 a gallon is a “savings” even though it is still twice as expensive as it was in 2020. The diesel fuel that drives our economy is over $5.00 a gallon. Heating oil and natural gas prices have skyrocketed, and our electricity rates are the 5th highest in the country.Across the state and country, Pingree, Biden and their progressive colleagues have forced Americans into the difficult position of deciding to put food on the table, staying warm, or putting gas in the car to get to work.As your representative in Congress, I will fight for a more measured and logical approach to our energy polices as we transition to renewable energy, one that doesn’t cause suffering for the 60% of Mainers who rely on heating oil to stay warm, or the more vulnerable members of our community (low income households, fixed income seniors, young families, etc.) who are being hurt by Maine’s high utility costs, including the 5th highest electricity rates in the country. I will fight to:
* Reopen Federal Lands for fossil fuel leases. Despite their assertions to the contrary, the Biden administration has leased fewer acres for oil-and-gas drilling, both offshore and on federal land, than any other administration dating back to the end of World War II. President Biden’s Interior Department leased 126,228 acres for drilling through Aug. 20, his first 19 months in office, the analysis found. No other president has leased out fewer than 4.4 million acres at this stage of their first term.

* Curb the administration’s efforts to further restrict current oil and gas production in the US, including current efforts to curtail oil and natural gas production in the Permian Basis (an area that provides 40% of our oil, and 10% of our natural gas).

* Ban or curtail the use of ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) investment scores.

* Increase the development and use of “reliable” energy sources like natural gas, nuclear, hydrogen, and biofuels like those currently being developed from wood waste in Maine.

It’s time to take decisions about our future out of the hands of extremists like Pingree. Please vote Thelander in November.

| | | **Friends,

Last week my team came to you with a plea to help us compete against the Democrats' hefty ad buys against me.

I wanted to let you know that I truly appreciate those who answered the call. [_We still need additional dollars,_](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=c84aef86fd&e=2fa613cb76) _but a donation is not the only way you can help make a big impact on my campaign._**
**There are plenty of ways you can help my campaign if a financial donation is not in your budget; from talking to your neighbors at their door to hosting a meet and greet with your friends. We’re also looking for help at parades, on the phones with voters, putting up yard signs and even helping out at our office. We know we can find a spot for you on Team Regan, so please reply to this email if you’d like to get off the sidelines.**

**I decided to get off the sidelines and now I’m asking you to join me by empowering our fellow Americans to stand up and take back this country. We are all tired of divisive politicians that are leaving us behind while working for the select few. That's why I am running as a parent, a small businesswoman, and a fighter to bring Representation back to "We The People" and not the out-of-touch bureaucrats in Washington.

Thank you,
Regan Deering
Republican Candidate for Congress, IL13**

As an actor, I’ve played many roles, but the ones that matter the most to me are the real-life roles I play: father, husband, neighbor, and especially these days, concerned citizen. The most direct line we have as citizens of this great nation to the people who govern us, is our inalienable right to pull the lever in the voting booth. But lately, many of our representatives have made it clear that they care more about a power grab than they do about protecting this country’s most fundamental right. When voting rights are attacked, it threatens the foundation of our democracy. As citizens, we must stand up and fight back. Fellow American,

My name is Catalina Lauf and I have a passion for people, public service and fighting for our American values.

I’m running for Congress in Illinois’ 11th Congressional District, but before I get into that - **I’d like to tell you a little bit about my story.**

My mom worked three-jobs at minimum wage to emigrate to America and became a leader in the community. My father grew-up with parents who barely made it through the Great Depression – yet started his own business and became a successful entrepreneur.

**My parents taught me the value of hard-work, liberty and to have an unapologetic love for our Country.**

I worked in the private sector (and still do for a growing startup!) and was a Presidential political appointee at the U.S. Department of Commerce, working on small-business initiatives, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and pro-growth policies.

[**Now I’m running for Congress because the freedom of opportunity (like I had) is at stake, Fellow American, and it will take outsiders - everyday Americans - to turn this Country around. clean_body: Join WFP members nationwide this Wednesday, September 7th at 7:30PM ET for our virtual teach-in as we gather to learn about this shared history and where we go from here. | | | Peter, To all the workers out there — we hope you enjoyed a joyful, restful Labor Day. At WFP, we’re fighting for a future in which working people — paid, unpaid, acknowledged and not — are valued, protected, fairly compensated, and treated with dignity. No matter where you work or what you do, we believe that you deserve a safe working environment, a living wage, guaranteed healthcare, and ample opportunity for rest and leisure. And we understand how important it is to revisit our past in order to chart the future in which the above is commonplace. During the event, we’ll be joined by Lane Windham, author of Knocking on Labor's Door , who will be sharing her research highlighting the struggles and contributions of those historically left out of labor narratives. This will be an opportunity for folks to revisit the radical roots of the Labor movement and reflect on the power of worker solidarity. And at a time when we’re seeing a new resurgence to nationwide unionization efforts — with workers at some of the largest employers in the nation standing up to corporate greed and saying enough is enough — it’s critical to draw lessons from the history that’s guiding this moment. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Why a simple yard sign is so important
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220906&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220906&amount=28]
Team,
After I ran an upset election in 2018, a GOP colleague told me afterward: “I knew you were going to win because of all of your yard signs!” In 2020, when we had to completely change the way we campaigned, I used to tell people yard signs were the best way to visibly show your support for a candidate. Kind of like your own personal billboard. That remains true now that I’m running to represent the 3 additional counties that make up Michigan’s new 7th district.
How do they help? First off, it really does help show the strength of a campaign when there are yard signs lining the streets. Particularly in a Republican-leaning district like ours. In some communities, putting a Democratic yard sign out is a controversial act. And for many Independents and Republicans, seeing their friends support a Democrat may give them the push to also consider splitting their vote.
And people take them seriously. We’ve witnessed more than one “yard sign war,” as we call them, between two neighbors on different sides of the aisle – who engage in a bit of friendly competition to see who can fit the most signs in their front yard.
And, since we’re number nerds on Team Slotkin, I thought I’d break down some quick yard sign numbers:
It costs about $5 to produce one of the standard yard signs you’re used to seeing during election season. We like to make it as easy as possible for folks to get their hands on these, so if you’re looking for a yard sign you can request one here [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe5B16-WwVP_HDEYilTrgwZLpW0vwU5Q0ZIoVD-nZH7O4LGkQ/viewform] – and a member of Team Slotkin will arrange a pickup time, or even deliver it right to your door.
If you live in or around the new 7th, you may also have seen our “jumbo” yard signs popping up on the side of the road. They are huge, and are great for busy intersections or along our many rural highways.

Dr. Oz won’t stop saying stupid sh*t.
#
Hey Derek, it’s Joe, John Fetterman’s Director of Communications.
Surprise surprise, Donald Trump and Dr. Oz continue to lie about their “values” and our campaign. They basically spent their entire rally last weekend lying about John.
**Another day, but it's the same sh*t from these two desperate and sad dudes.**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220906-2?refcode=em20220906-7151&refcode2=7151_434096_Yb_GXN&akid=7151%2E434096%2EYb_GXN)
_There’s a Sopranos quote for every situation 🤌_
Their sad attempts to try and discredit John and this campaign are embarrassing, Derek. Especially given all the stupid things Oz has said in the past few weeks...
From buying crudité at “Wegners” to lying about how many houses he owns to acting like everyone can afford Gucci loafers and custom Zegna suits, Dr. Oz has proven time and time again that he is out of touch with PA.
To put it plain and simple, Derek: Oz does not give a sh*t about the working people of Pennsylvania + doesn't have a clue what people are going through.
**[So we’ve gotta beat him. Could you please make a donation right now to help us keep up with Dr. Oz’s self-funding campaign? With just NINE weeks until the general election, we need youse guys to chip in whenever you can.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220906-2?refcode=em20220906-7151&refcode2=7151_434096_Yb_GXN&akid=7151%2E434096%2EYb_GXN)**

This guy has zero understanding of what day-to-day life looks like for the working people of PA who are struggling to pay bills + afford groceries.
And he wants to write the laws for us?? Fuggedaboutit.
**Let’s send Dr. Oz packing back to one of his many mega-mansions. You in?**
**[Please consider chipping in $5 or whatever you can, cuz unlike Dr. Oz, we’re actually relying on small-dollar donations to win this race.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220906-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220906-7151&refcode2=7151_434096_Yb_GXN&akid=7151%2E434096%2EYb_GXN)**

body:
Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.”

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

[**Help Republicans retake Congress
and save America. ⇒**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f22e1e5e256c4ceaa93a9e212d8fb5a9&_e=hONsxwnwMRmOCyLwCRF5JS35PgGrnLBYvQMNuwIvXZWUw3miF8Q1obKs773uru9Ntmc93iBjAFqeEUdeDPMNzt-1WOR4ffLOw_Ii4kh0UYCq1Hjrw13_W2ElWvIontA0spIzsGYq97Xj1NaILuSA_asPmxdY-SODhfoHmoJTqRWjEXIlF6m7rd8yE2pX5J2Z5fs5U8Muoz2rfEIdAq6SqCGnyFheODyx9LCELbDAQrhl6LRYq3qHTeegWojOa95gcUtBLfxt3jFOMGKILGVRqkKoUPMwl0eJdlEZzmlAn5jDjyG3kzIa1Sm3Sxf--KIbPpHi22gq5dz9OjzgXWQuxEnTve_AfgUUAx4FyFzRq5z3AFHkSnDi9iVCLAbnYlv6rriPCqYf92DWJpx3CaTaqpi-LuImyjA8wYaRKfJkowblFidPUHgli0P_BsfdK-A0Wb2zVCE0_2I6JpxqFFagFg%3D%3D)
It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[**Will you help us win back
our Republican majority? ⇒**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f22e1e5e256c4ceaa93a9e212d8fb5a9&_e=hONsxwnwMRmOCyLwCRF5JS35PgGrnLBYvQMNuwIvXZWUw3miF8Q1obKs773uru9Ntmc93iBjAFqeEUdeDPMNzt-1WOR4ffLOw_Ii4kh0UYCq1Hjrw13_W2ElWvIontA0spIzsGYq97Xj1NaILuSA_asPmxdY-SODhfoHmoJTqRWjEXIlF6m7rd8yE2pX5J2Z5fs5U8Muoz2rfEIdAq6SqCGnyFheODyx9LCELbDAQrhl6LRYq3qHTeegWojOa95gcUtBLfxt3jFOMGKILGVRqkKoUPMwl0eJdlEZzmlAn5jDjyG3kzIa1Sm3Sxf--KIb429edem0B7jDUbquIh21EylOsMaQubJ_WwNc4vGR07iWPYivDMDUGuwRZfZioYZj_dc-EpVnQ6swXbnTzYShJuCJIFbRyXnj1QUMrj2ls-ifQZEw37Dce0EfUT9lK0IQXdolozjA36fZl2F4eGvJgA%3D%3D)
We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

clean_body: Dear Peter, Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.” My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing. We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty. It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights. The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington. We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country. We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?
